findings.title: Failed 'Add entry' wipes the text the user typed
findings.where: Plant detail page /plants/:id, Journal > New entry (pages/plants/[id].vue addEntry)
findings.steps: Open /plants/2, make POST /api/journal fail (e.g. 500), type 'My important note 🌱' in Entry, click Add entry.
findings.expected: Error shown and the typed text stays in the textarea so the user can retry.
findings.actual: Error 'Could not add the entry.' is shown but the textarea is emptied, because entryForm.reset() is called in the finally block on both success and failure.
findings.evidence: After the failed POST the textarea value was '' and the alert read 'Could not add the entry.'

findings.title: Journal saves have no timeout; button stays 'Saving…' forever when the server hangs
findings.where: Plant detail page: Add entry, Edit entry save, Delete entry (useApiClient has no timeout)
findings.steps: Make POST /api/journal hang (never respond), type text, click Add entry, wait more than 10 s.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s with a visible error, and the button is enabled again.
findings.actual: The button still read 'Saving…' and stayed disabled after 12 s, with no error. The same applies to edit (PUT) and delete (DELETE).
findings.evidence: Submit button text was 'Saving…' 12 s after the click.

findings.title: Journal page error state has no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/journal?... return 503, go from Plants to Journal using the nav link.
findings.expected: Error message with a Retry button that reloads the entries.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load the journal.' is shown, with no button. The user has to reload or change the search to recover.
findings.evidence: Main area showed the alert and no buttons (the main button list was empty).

findings.title: Plant detail journal list error has no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/journal?plant_id=... fail and open a plant.
findings.expected: Error state with a retry button.
findings.actual: The code shows only an AlertMessage with no retry button (refreshJournal is never offered to the user).
findings.evidence: Code: pages/plants/[id].vue renders <AlertMessage v-if="journalLoadError"> without any retry control.

findings.title: Out-of-range ids give 500 instead of 4xx
findings.actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (SQLite integer overflow).
findings.evidence: curl returned 'Internal Server Error [500]' for both requests.

findings.title: Absurd journal dates accepted and shown oddly
findings.expected: Dates before a sensible minimum are refused with a reason.
findings.actual: The entry is accepted (201), shown as '1 Jan 1', and sorted to the bottom.
findings.evidence: 201 response. The time element rendered '1 Jan 1'.

findings.title: 'Future date' check uses server date vs browser date
findings.steps: Use a browser in a timezone ahead of the server's around midnight and pick today's local date.
findings.actual: The client allows it (todayIso is local) but the server's date.today() may still be yesterday, so it answers 'Journal date cannot be in the future.'
